visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a vibrant promotional banner for Lawson's new fried chicken outside a store; a hand enters the frame gesturing towards it. (2) The camera cuts to the interior of a Lawson store, focusing on the hot food display case where several boxes of 'Karaage-kun' fried chicken are arranged, specifically the ginger and green onion flavors. (3) A young woman with dark hair, wearing a white knit sweater and a black hooded scarf, stands outdoors and takes a big bite of the green onion flavored chicken, winking at the camera. (4) A close-up shot shows her hands breaking the golden-brown fried chicken piece in half, revealing a white meat interior heavily flecked with bright green chopped onions. (5) The woman is seen again, now holding the ginger flavor box, taking a bite and reacting with an intense, wide-eyed expression. (6) Another close-up reveals the interior of the ginger chicken, showing small bits of ginger embedded in the meat. (7) The final phase shows the woman's humorous reaction as she rolls her eyes and shakes her head, with a digital 'star' overlay appearing around her head to emphasize the strong taste.
